match_spec.normalise: lower case; apostrophes ‘ ’ ʻ ʼ ` ´ → ASCII '. NO ё → е folding (NI1): Uzbek Cyrillic ё is a letter of its own.
match_spec.letter_rule: In a term, Russian 'е' also accepts 'ё' in the message (ребенок matches ребёнок); a term 'ё' needs 'ё' (ёш, ёқ, аёл, оёқ). Terms, stems, unless/requires items and parser patterns are all written in normalised form and pass through the same normalisation as the message.
match_spec.word: a term (one or more space-separated words) matches equal consecutive tokens
match_spec.stem: each word of a term is a prefix of the consecutive token at its position
match_spec.near: one item per group, all within 'window' tokens (max position − min position < window), any order. An item may be multi-word: it then matches consecutive tokens (prefix match per word in 'stem' mode) and all its tokens count as matched positions (NS5).
match_spec.not_prefix: a token that also starts with one of these never counts
match_spec.unless_any: the entry is skipped when any item matches; a multi-word item matches consecutive tokens (NS5), so 'ko'krak suti' is live
match_spec.requires_any: the entry fires only when some item matches and is not itself negated (r4: 'не беременна' is no pregnancy context), multi-word allowed, or the slot named by requires_slot is already true
match_spec.precedence: ambulance → (inside Graf only) doctor → hard_exclusion → note → vocab; a non-negated ambulance hit wins over everything
match_spec.ambulance_tiers: r4: every ambulance entry has tier 'strong' or 'weak'. Message tier = 'strong' if any strong entry hits (not negated) → 103 at once; else 'weak' if any weak entry hits or a strong entry hits negated → emergency.check (asks 'прямо сейчас и сильно?'); else none. Reply to emergency.check: yes or unclear → 103; no → the previous customer message continues in the normal flow with ambulance hits ignored for that message (engine.emergency_check).
match_spec.clauses: Clause boundaries for negation: , . ; : ! ? newline, em/en dash, ' - '.
match_spec.acceptance_gate: every entry has >= 1 positive and >= 1 negative self-test row, all pass, and 'never fired' = 0 (NI3)

negation.rule: A hit is negated when a 'before' token stands within 2 tokens before a matched token, or an 'after' token directly follows the last matched token. Tokens inside the match do not count. r3: window_after = 1, so an unrelated 'нет' later in the message ('давит в груди, температуры нет') no longer negates a sign (review NB3). r4: negation never crosses a clause boundary (, . ; : ! ? or a dash), so 'нет, кормлю грудью' keeps the lactation word (review r3 I2). Negated vocab/note/exclusion/doctor hits are ignored; a negated ambulance hit becomes 'ask_check' (emergency.check). Entries with "negation": false ignore the rule.

NI2: neither yes nor no → re-ask
word mode (I3: 'женат' must not hit 'жена'); 'супруг/супруга' is ambiguous and left out

'qiz' as a stem would hit 'qizarish' (redness): word mode

vocab_rules.yes_no: NI2: 'unknown' words (не знаю, bilmayman …), a reply with both yes and no words, or no word at all → unparsed → one re-ask. Bare 'не' is not a no-word.
vocab_rules.whom: NI2: one relation per reply. A relation word beats a self word ('я для мамы' → mother). Two different relations → unparsed (ask.whom_age again).

pregnancy_reply.rule: review r3 I2 / S3: in a reply to ask.pregnancy / reask.pregnancy, a non-negated pregnancy or lactation word (safety.json notes note.preg.*, or lactation_reply_words) sets the slot true even after 'нет' ('нет, кормлю грудью' → true, D25); a negated one ('ҳомиладор эмасман') does not; otherwise the yes/no rule decides.

parsers.normalisation: lower case + ASCII apostrophe; NO ё → е folding (NI1). Patterns below are written for normalised text; Russian е is written [её].

ru.note: мне / ему / сыну … N [лет|месяцев|недель]; unit optional ('мне 30')
review r3 B2: 'у сына 5 лет', 'у дочки 3 года'; dropped only with a duration adverb next to it
'сын 5 лет' — subject to the duration guard

age.rule: Age is read only with an age marker (NB4): a 'strong' match is always an age; a 'genitive' match ('у сына 5 лет') is dropped only when a duration adverb (duration_adverbs) stands within 2 tokens in the same clause; a 'weak' (nominative) match is dropped when any duration marker does. A dropped match is never re-read as a duration (review r3 B2). As the reply to ask.age / ask.age_self / ask.whom_age / reask.age, a number with an optional age unit ('7', '7 лет', '8 месяцев', '25 yosh') or a word from reply_words ('полгода') is an age (0 < n <= 110). Months → years / 12, weeks → years × 7 / 365. Two different ages → ask again. No age marker → no age (ask).

duration.rule: Spans read as an age, and spans dropped as an age, are removed first. Days, weeks and months count as written; years ('N лет / года / yil / йил') count only next to a duration adverb ('уже 2 года', '2 yildan beri'). Ordinals ('второй день', 'ikkinchi kun') and unit-first forms ('дня три') are durations (review r3 I1). The largest duration wins.

temperature.rule: 35.0–42.9 with a unit right after it, or after a fever word within 1 token; digits never glue to other digits ('3800 г' no); 'мне 38 лет' no

self_test.note: Rows per entry (>= 1 positive, >= 1 negative each), the review r2 NB3 examples, and parser tests (age, duration, temperature, yes/no, whom). Run with the reference matcher/parser of this build; semantics = match_spec + parsers.
